reviewMethod: Read the exact new recovery SQL literal and its database.customSelect call. The statement is a parameterized internal query and is never presented to users; exclude it from localization. No product, test or extraction-tool source was changed.

decisions.template: SELECT key, value FROM preferences WHERE substr(key, 1, ?) = ? AND CASE WHEN json_valid(value) THEN json_type(value, '$.healthReceiptRecovery') = 'object' AND json_type(value, '$.healthReceiptRecovery.conversationId') = 'text' AND json_extract(value, '$.healthReceiptRecovery.conversationId') = ? AND json_type(value, '$.healthReceiptRecovery.receiptAcknowledged') = 'false' AND json_extract(value, '$.ownerScope') = ? AND json_extract(value, '$.command.kind') = 'health' AND json_type(value, '$.command.operationId') = 'text' AND key = ? || json_extract(value, '$.command.operationId') ELSE 0 END ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT ?
decisions.reason: Only passed to database.customSelect. SQL keywords, JSON paths and placeholders are protocol syntax, not UI copy.

rebuildRule: The raw extractor remains conservative. Reapply this reviewed exclusion only if the source SHA-256 and exact literal template hash match; otherwise review again.
